description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It sets up a fragment-based UI with a ViewPager for swipe navigation and an ActionBar with tabs to switch between sections. It includes inner classes for a FragmentPagerAdapter and a placeholder Fragment that displays section-specific content.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity that manages the tabbed interface with a ViewPager for fragment navigation and an ActionBar for tab selection.

classes.name: MainActivity$SectionsPagerAdapter
classes.description: A FragmentPagerAdapter that supplies fragments for each tab/page in the ViewPager.

classes.name: MainActivity$DummySectionFragment
classes.description: A placeholder fragment displaying a section label, used as content for each page.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components including ActionBar tabs and ViewPager.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Synchronizes the ViewPager's current page with the selected tab.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Unused, but required by TabListener interface.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Unused, but required by TabListener interface.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Provides the fragment for each page based on position, creating dummy fragments with section numbers.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of pages (3).

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Provides the title for each tab/page based on position.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the fragment view, inflates layout, and sets section number text.
